Description

About us

We’re a team of like-minded thinkers who have long been convinced that we’re living in the earliest stages of a global financial revolution. This revolution is being fuelled by decentralized finance which is enabling pioneering developers and entrepreneurs to re-invent almost every financial product that is currently traded and invested in traditional markets, we are building a global team to deliver on this mission and Jersey is central to that strategy.

What is the role?

The primary function of the junior compliance officer role will be to assist the compliance manger to ensure compliance with procedures and legislation, updating compliance registers and logs, scanning, and filing of compliance-related documentation, alongside the preparation and processing of client due diligence and general administration for the compliance team. As a technology company we use a variety of technologies for this as well as blockchain analytics to analyse transaction history. The position is based in Jersey and you need to have entitled to work status.

What will you be doing?

  • Assist the compliance manager and other staff with the efficient onboarding of new token-holders and business partners
  • Carrying out sample testing of CDD collected via the Company’s electronic identity verification suppliers, as directed by the Board
  • Assessing the CDD collected for compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements and where appropriate, escalate non-compliant cases
  • Reviewing and evaluating sanctions and PEP checks and discounting or escalating, as appropriate
  • Carrying out transaction monitoring in accordance with the Company’s policies and procedures, as directed by the Board
  • Assist with carrying out manual CDD collection and assessment, where necessary
  • Assist with updating and monitoring centralised databases and reporting to the Board
  • Ensuring compliance with the Company’s internal policies & procedures, and also relevant legislation and regulatory requirements
  • Understand and be able to demonstrate understanding of AML related procedures relevant to the role

Requirements

What skills do you need?

Preference will be given to those with:

  • One years’ plus experience of working in an Anti-Money Laundering or Client Due Diligence environment
  • An understanding of regulatory requirements in Jersey
  • Holding an AML certification, or similar relevant qualification, or be willing to undertake study to complete certification after completion of probation
  • Knowledge of or interest in DeFi and Cryptocurrency
  • Good organisational & communication skills
  • Be able to exercise discretion and confidentiality at all times
  • Professional, confident and have a positive approach
  • Ability to prioritise and meet deadlines
  • Good IT skills - including proficient use of MS Excel and MS Word
  • A flexible approach to work, including being prepared to get your ‘hands dirty’
  • Desire to gain technical knowledge and a wide range of experience


About Radix

Radix is the first layer-one protocol specifically built to serve DeFi. This protocol is the basis of the Radix public network – a fully decentralized platform for DeFi applications and users. Decentralized finance applications are currently built on protocols that are not fit for this purpose, leading to congestion, hacks and developer frustration. Radix changes this by introducing a scalable, secure-by-design, composable platform with a DeFi centric development environment to make it easy to build and launch scalable DeFi products. Radix Tokens (Jersey) is the token issuing arm of the Radix group, which is also responsible for building fiat and crypto on and off ramps for the Radix network.
